exposure: Interval between steroid administration and glucose tolerance test
cohort: 184 women who underwent intrauterine fetal spina bifida repair between 24 and 26 gestational weeks from 2010 to 2022.
finding: The incidence of gestational diabetes in women after fetal spina bifida repair was higher than in the usual pregnant population, and early mobilization, rapid tocolytic decrease, and shorter length of stay could benefit pregnancy course and potentially decrease the risk for GD without increasing preterm delivery risk.
gest_age: Fetal spina bifida repair was performed between 24 and 26 gestational weeks; gestational age at delivery was an outcome measure (mean GA at delivery was 37.1 GWs in early mobilized group vs. 36.2 GWs in the remaining cohort).
